name: Footalytics
tagline: AI football prediction chat with a public, pre-registered accuracy ledger — every pick is published before kick-off and graded after full
description:
AI football prediction chat with a public, pre-registered accuracy ledger — every pick is published before kick-off and graded after full time, misses included. Start free — 1 free prediction every day. Top up with credit packs when you need more. Free: 1 free chat prediction every day, plus 5 free API calls per account (lifetime, not per day).

Ask who wins and get the numbers: win/draw/loss, over 2.5 goals, both teams to score and correct score for every match. Every match is settled in public after full time — misses stay on the record too. Every settled prediction is public — wins and losses, none missing. Verify any call in the ledger, the CSV export or the archive. Win/draw/loss (1X2), over 2.5 goals, both teams to score (BTTS) and correct score — every call explained in plain words. Official picks appear 24–48 h before each kick-off. It gives probabilities with reasons.

Start with the ledger — free. Read the ledger first, for as long as you like — no rush to pay. When you're ready: 1 free prediction every day, in six languages. You get free predictions when you sign up, no card needed. Paid packs add volume when you want more. Every question uses one free prediction first — you get 1 free prediction every day. When free predictions run out, questions use credits, billed by the actual AI usage of each answer. Purchased credits never expire.

Cancel it yourself anytime in Settings — no emails, no calls, no retention maze. After cancelling, you keep everything until the end of the paid period. Credits you buy never expire. No ads — ever.

Chat-based AI football predictions: real fixtures, public data and a Poisson model — every official pick settled against the real score. The Footalytics skill plugs the same analyst into ChatGPT and Claude, and there is a public API for developers. Four JSON endpoints — predictions, fixtures, teams and settled results — with the same graded probabilities. 5 free API calls per account, then 1 credit per call. No monthly fee — top up credits as you go. MCP server included for AI assistants. Chat built for phones first.

27 leagues — the Premier League, La Liga, Bundesliga, Serie A, Champions League, MLS, Brasileirão and more. Predictions are statistical probabilities for information and entertainment only, never betting advice.
